t: A small boxed LoRa radio from M5Stack built for Meshtastic text messaging.
steps: Buy the Unit C6L from The Pi Hut, Mouser, RobotShop, or the M5Stack store.
Screw on both antennas before powering it up.
Open the Meshtastic web flasher in Chrome and pick the Unit C6L target.
Flash the latest Meshtastic firmware over USB-C.
Install the Meshtastic app on a phone and pair over Bluetooth.
Set your region and match the modem preset on every node.
Send a test message to a second node across the house.
Get a 915 MHz antenna for better range in the US.
meta: Open Board. From $22.90. A few stores.
